metadata.scoring_logic: Evidence-Based Priority Score (Heuristic). Unweighted sum of 4 available dimensions (Frequency, Evidence Strength, Purchase Relevance, Intent Relevance).

prioritized_opportunities.hypothesis: Capacity limits and lack of category filtering cause high friction when retrieving saved items.
prioritized_opportunities.validation_gap: Requires clickstream data to measure time-to-find items in wishlist and abandonment rate on wishlist page.

prioritized_opportunities.hypothesis: Users use the wishlist as a holding area for out-of-stock or unserviceable items. Not resolving these states prevents conversion.
prioritized_opportunities.validation_gap: Requires internal telemetry to prove how long items remain OOS in wishlists and if they convert upon restock.

prioritized_opportunities.hypothesis: Price-hesitant users use wishlists to monitor prices. High hidden fees (convenience fee) shock them at checkout.
prioritized_opportunities.validation_gap: Requires telemetry to show if wishlisted items are abandoned specifically when convenience fees are applied.
